battle73_wingmantips.en: Press E to activate the array

battle_CoreBeAttack.en: The Array Core is under attack!

battle_EtoM1.ch: 哼！好啊，现在只有你一个，咱们决斗吧！
battle_EtoM1.en: Humph! Alright, since you are all alone here, let's duel!

battle_EtoME1.ch: 哦，我明白了，你要独占杀死对手的功劳！
battle_EtoME1.en: I got it. You want to steal the credit for killing the enemy!

battle_EtoME2.ch: 哈！好机会，我们合力将他毙了！
battle_EtoME2.en: Ha! I see a chance. Let's join forces and kill him!

battle_EtoME3.ch: 不要逞强，你十年前宗门比试伤了老腰，我来会他！
battle_EtoME3.en: Don't push yourself. You hurt your back at the Sect Arena 10 years ago. Let me deal with him!

battle_EtoMEtoE1.en: The enemy is strong. Help me!

battle_EtoMEtoE2.ch: 我一个人就能轻易对付他，你不要插手。咦！对手很强，快来帮我。
battle_EtoMEtoE2.en: I can handle him alone easily. Don't interfere. Wait, the opponent is strong. Help me!

battle_EtoMEtoE3.en: What are you waiting for? Help me!

battle_EtoMF3.ch: 敌人有两个，我只孤身一人，今天要交代在这了！
battle_EtoMF3.en: Two enemies, yet I'm alone. Looks like I'm going to die here!

battle_EtoMFE1.ch: 哼，以二敌一，胜之不武！我来帮你！
battle_EtoMFE1.en: Two on one is unfair. Let me even out the numbers!

battle_EtoMFE2.ch: 现在我们各有两人，打起来才有点意思！
battle_EtoMFE2.en: Now, this is much better. Two versus two!

battle_EtoMFE3.ch: 好啊，你们仗着人多欺负我的同伴么？
battle_EtoMFE3.en: Are you guys bullying my friend?

battle_EtoMFEtoF1.ch: 好！现在我们可没占你便宜，死了可别抱怨！
battle_EtoMFEtoF1.en: Great! Now, this is a fair fight, so don't complain if you die!

battle_EtoMFEtoF2.en: What a nuisance! They have help!

battle_EtoMFEtoF3.ch: 咦，敌人来帮手了，赶紧杀了这个落单的！
battle_EtoMFEtoF3.en: Enemy's help is here. Let's kill this lone one now!

battle_EtoMFtoF1.ch: 哼，怪就怪你落单了！我们一起上！
battle_EtoMFtoF1.en: It's your own fault to be alone! We'll crush you!

battle_EtoMFtoF2.ch: 天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你闯进来！

battle_EtoMFtoF3.ch: 只有一个？你来对付还是我来对付？
battle_EtoMFtoF3.en: Only one enemy? Yours or mine?

battle_FleeFail1.en: This is bad. There's no hope to escape.

battle_FleeFail2.en: Blast. I might die here today!

battle_FleeFail3.ch: 没想到这里便是我埋骨之所！
battle_FleeFail3.en: I didn't expect to be buried in such a place!

battle_FtoM1.ch: 你单独行动，只怕不安全，我来陪你！
battle_FtoM1.en: Being alone is dangerous. I'll join you!

battle_FtoM2.ch: 这里十分危险，你不该独自行动，我们互相照应吧。
battle_FtoM2.en: This place is dangerous. Let's watch each other's back.

battle_FtoME1.ch: 啊？原来你在这里遇上敌人了？我来帮你！
battle_FtoME1.en: Huh? Are you fighting enemies? I'm coming to help!

battle_FtoME2.ch: 别急，我来帮你对付敌人。
battle_FtoME2.en: Don't worry, I'm here to help.

battle_FtoME3.ch: 区区一个敌人，你能应付吧？
battle_FtoME3.en: There's only one enemy. You can deal with that, right?

battle_FtoMEtoE1.ch: 哼！来了同伙了？今日来一个杀一个，来一双杀一双！
battle_FtoMEtoE1.en: More help? All of you will die here!

battle_FtoMEtoE2.ch: 喂喂，你可不许帮你同门对付我！
battle_FtoMEtoE2.en: Hey, don't you help your sect fellows!

battle_FtoMEtoE3.ch: 我们厮杀得难分难解，你的同伴万万不该介入的！
battle_FtoMEtoE3.en: We were having a good fight. Your friend shouldn't have interfered!

battle_FtoMF1.ch: 嗯？你们都在！正好，我们都一起行动吧！
battle_FtoMF1.en: Huh? You are all here! Perfect, I'll tag along and join you!

battle_FtoMF2.ch: 人多好办事，人多好办事啊！

battle_FtoMF3.ch: 若是杀死又或拿下敌人，你们不会跟我争功吧？
battle_FtoMF3.en: If we kill or capture enemies, you won't steal my credit, right?

battle_FtoMFE1.ch: 啊？遇上敌人了？要我帮忙么？
battle_FtoMFE1.en: Did you run into enemies? Need a hand?

battle_FtoMFE2.ch: 你攻上三路，他攻下三路，咦，那我呢？
battle_FtoMFE2.en: You aim at the torso, and he attacks the legs. Wait, what about me?

battle_FtoMFEtoE1.ch: 哼！你们就是以三敌一，我又何惧？
battle_FtoMFEtoE1.en: Even if there are three of you. I'm not afraid!

battle_FtoMFEtoE2.ch: 无耻之徒，你们真要一起上么?
battle_FtoMFEtoE2.en: You shameless! Are you going to attack me all at once?

battle_FtoMFEtoE3.en: Bullying the outnumbered. Shame on you!

battle_MtoEtoE1.en: Look, a fish that slipped away!

battle_MtoF1.ch: 你来了以后我心中镇静不少！
battle_MtoF1.en: I feel much less nervous since you're here!

battle_MtoF2.ch: 是你？太好了！来，你走前面！
battle_MtoF2.en: It's you? Excellent! Come, you go first!

battle_MtoF3.en: I was so worried that it was an enemy!

battle_MtoFE1.ch: 啊，你来得正好，快来帮我对付这厮！
battle_MtoFE1.en: Oh, perfect timing. Help me deal with this bastard!

battle_MtoFE2.ch: 不要帮我，我一个就能对付他！
battle_MtoFE2.en: Don't help me. I can deal with him myself!

battle_MtoFE3.en: Please help! I'm from your sect!

battle_MtoFEtoE1.ch: 不要以多欺少，有种就和我单打独斗！
battle_MtoFEtoE1.en: Do you dare fight me one on one?!

battle_MtoFEtoE2.ch: 废物，你就不敢和我单挑？！
battle_MtoFEtoE2.en: You trash! Duel me one of one if you dare!

battle_MtoFEtoE3.ch: 来啊，你们一起上！我能打十个！
battle_MtoFEtoE3.en: Bring it on! I can take out ten of you at a time!

battle_TryFlee1.ch: 情况不妙，不如先行撤退，改日准备好了再卷土重来！
battle_TryFlee1.en: This is looking bad. Let's retreat and prepare for our comeback!

battle_TryFlee2.ch: 包羞忍耻才是大人物本色，我们撤！
battle_TryFlee2.en: There's no shame in a strategic retreat. Let's go!

battle_TryFlee3.ch: 我们先行撤吧，等敌人锐气殆尽，我们再马上反击。
battle_TryFlee3.en: Let's retreat for now and fight back when their momentum gets weak.

battle_ataticMessage5.ch: 收到{0}传音：大家自由发挥。
